content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — Smart-routing anomalies detected (auto-alert).
incident-bot: Summary: increased 5xx and incorrect variant outputs for a subset of traffic. Suspected cache/KV reuse across model+region prefixes.

Maria Chen: getting paged, on it. Observed spike in app-error-rate for `model:rdw-small:v2` around 12:07 UTC.
Kevin Patel: I'm seeing similar in the routing logs — requests that were supposed to go to `variant=v2 region=us-east-1` are getting KV hits for `variant=v1 region=us-west-2`. Looks like KV prefixing logic dropped variant/region tag on some shards.
Sasha Ivanov: tagging severity — customer-impacting. Affected customers: acme-inc (replies with stale persona), orbit-ads (served wrong embeddings). Suggest sev2.
David Ortiz: paging SRE rotation to confirm infra mitigation — @pagerduty-bot please escalate to current oncall.
pagerduty-bot: Paging: oncall-sre is now notified.

Maria Chen: quick mitigation plan: 1) Stop global fallback routing (disable auto-fallback rule) 2) Evict suspect KV prefixes 3) Pin critical customers to explicit routing rule until patch.
Kevin Patel: agree. Stopping auto-fallback now. Command: `./control-plane routing disable-policy --name auto-fallback`
Kevin Patel: policy stop confirmed — `ok` from control-plane at 12:14:09 UTC.

Sasha Ivanov: running targeted KV eviction for keys that may have lost variant/region namespace. Example command:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://internal-kv-admin/api/v1/evict" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"prefixes": ["model:rdw-small:v1:region:us-west-2", "model:rdw-small:v2:region:us-east-1"]}'
```
Sasha Ivanov: eviction job queued (job id 3f7a).

Maria Chen: note — do NOT evict the entire namespace; we want to avoid cold-starting all shards. Targeted prefixes only.
David Ortiz: I'll deploy a temporary routing override to pin `acme-inc` traffic to `rdw-small:v2` in us-east-1. Patch applied at 12:18:02 UTC.

Kevin Patel: adding a fast health-check for cached responses. If a cached response TTL is older than 60s and model/region metadata mismatch, mark cache miss. Quick config: `routing.runtime.cache.tolerance=60s`

incident-bot: Action log updated. Incident creation: 1758904321.

Sasha Ivanov: quick log snippet showing mis-routed request: 
```txt
[12:11:52] request_id=rcq-9345 route=smart-route user=acme-inc model=rdw-small:v2 region=us-east-1 -> cache_hit key=model:rdw-small:v1:region:us-west-2
```

Maria Chen: customer impact assessment: ~0.4% of production traffic affected over 11 minutes; two paying customers reported incorrect outputs. No PII leakage observed.
Kevin Patel: metrics: token-error-rate +1200% on variant v2. Latency unchanged. Fallback loop observed when fallback policy routes to different region and cache then serves mismatched variant, triggering further fallbacks.

David Ortiz: mitigation status: fallback policy disabled ✅, targeted eviction in progress (3/12 prefixes evicted) 🔄, routing overrides applied for top 5 affected customers ✅.

Sasha Ivanov: suggested next steps: 1) full roll-forward patch to include variant+region in KV key-generation 2) add unit/integration test for hybrid fallback scenarios 3) post-incident follow-up and customer comms draft.

Maria Chen: I'll own the rollback/patch plan. Kevin, can you produce a minimal repro to run in staging?
Kevin Patel: working on a reproducible script that simulates concurrent fallback and cache races. Will drop it in #eng-runtime-staging in ~30m.

incident-bot: On-call handoff reminder: current oncall (Maria Chen) will remain lead for next 45 minutes; if no resolution, escalate to rotation lead (Sasha Ivanov).

David Ortiz: status page update proposed: "Partial degradation of smart-routing for rdw-small observed; targeted mitigation in progress."
Maria Chen: +1, please include ETA 1h for full mitigation.

Sasha Ivanov: running smoke tests against pinned routes now. 
Sasha Ivanov: smoke tests PASSED for pinned customers at 12:36:11 UTC.

Kevin Patel: eviction job finished at 12:40:05 UTC. Observed drop in 5xx and mismatch events.

Maria Chen: leaving running checks for 30m. Will move to postmortem when stabilized. Great cross-team execution — thanks. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated — monitoring. Severity updated to Sev2 -> Postmortem pending.

David Ortiz: postmortem owners: Maria Chen, Kevin Patel, Sasha Ivanov. I'll open doc in incident retro board and assign action items.

Maria Chen: final note for RCA: primary root cause appears to be a regression in a recent routing refactor that normalized cache keys but omitted variant+region tags on a subset of routing shards; this allowed cross-variant reuse during fallback storms. We'll include that in the postmortem and recommend a short-lived guardrail to refuse cache hits that don't match request metadata until we ship the key-fix.
